Name: Lovely Buildable Kitchen (CP)
Author: lululovely
Description:
Want to start cooking before you've upgraded the farmhouse to include a kitchen? Maybe you want to expand the kitchen, or completely get rid of it and rebuild it as you like? Add a kitchen to a shed! Put a run of cabinets in your greenhouse! Whatever, wherever, you can build a lovely modular kitchen.
[line]

[b]* * *   REQUIREMENTS   * * *[/b]
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Calcifer
Optional: (CP) Empty Kitchens
[line]

[b]* * *   INSTRUCTIONS   * * *[/b]

- Install the required mods.
- Download this mod, unzip it, and place the "[CP] Lovely Buildable Kitchen" folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
- Run the game after installing to generate a config file. Either edit the file directly or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).[/url]
- Buy the [b]Lovely Buildable Kitchen Catalogue[/b] from Robin.
- You can also find the items in the vanilla furniture catalogue.

This mod will not remove or alter the original kitchen. You can get rid of the kitchen with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33852](CP) Empty Kitchen[/url] or change it to a matching style with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123]my original Lovely Kitchen mod.[/url]
[line]

[b]* * *   CONFIGURATION OPTIONS   * * *[/b]
Choose your cabinet, appliance, counter, and hardware colors. Add a pour-over coffee maker on a wooden cart if you like.

- Cabinet Color: gray, pink, birch, white, yellow, red, mint, green, walnut, cream, lilac, purple, sky, blue, oak, black, navy, or orange
- Appliance Color: pink, sky, mint, white, cream, stainless, copper, or black
- Countertop Color: light, medium, or dark
- Hardware Color: red, blue, silver, nickel, bronze, black, gold, or brass
- Coffee Maker: true or false

* PRICING NOTE *
If you want to change the cost of buying the catalogue from Robin (1000g), you can open the shops.json file in the Data folder and change the price.
[line]

[b]* * * POSSIBLE FUTURE UPDATES * * *[/b]

- Fridges that function. I sat on this mod for months with everything working except the fridges, so I decided to release it with the fridges being decorative.

- Matching the Telephone and Coffee Maker to the kitchen. The graphics are done but it was much trickier than expected to code! For now, my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras[/url] mod can do this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] instead.
[line]

[b]* * *  MY LOVELY SERIES OF MODS * * *[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123][b]Lovely Kitchen (CP)[/b][/url]
- The original! Replaces the kitchens in the farmhouse, cabins, and island.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541][b]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT)[/b][/url]
- Designed to add on to the original with new kitchen islands and extras (just like the name says).

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8314][b]Lovely Coffee Maker (CP)[/b][/url]
- A pour-over coffee maker on a wooden cart. Included in the other kitchen mods, but also available as a standalone.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40941][b]Lovely Wall Panels (CP)[/b][/url]
- Wallpaper and wall panels that match the Lovely Kitchen perfectly.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20978][b]Lovely Buildable Kitchen (CP)[/b][/url]
- Build your own kitchen however and wherever you like.
